error_code: Error i20 / i30 / 2 or 3 LED Flashes
symptom: The Frigidaire dishwasher refuses to start a new wash cycle, runs the drain pump for 2 minutes on an empty tub, and stops flashing i20 (or blinks the status LED twice).
technical_cause: Grease and detergent buildup inside the bottom sump pressure switch port has fouled the diaphragm inside the analog water level pressure sensor (5304504077 / A00126401).
oem_part_name: Frigidaire Updated Dishwasher Water Level Pressure Sensor Kit
affiliate_search_query: 5304504077 A00126401 Frigidaire dishwasher pressure sensor i20
diagnostic_steps: Unplug the dishwasher and remove the bottom front kickplate.
Locate the black/grey plastic pressure sensor (5304504077) clipped to the front of the plastic sump, blow out the air trap port, and snap in the updated 5304504077 sensor kit.

faq.q: Why did Frigidaire release part 5304504077 as a kit with a plastic siphon insert?
faq.a: The updated 5304504077 kit includes a redesigned white plastic air-chamber insert that stops grease from entering the sensor tube.
